data.title: Corridors with corners
story: A new warehouse just opened and its corridors turn right. The old program keeps moving until it hits a wall.
New sensor: front_clear() is True when the tile in front of the robot is not a wall. Use if/else: if the front is clear move forward, otherwise turn right.

explanation: if/else picks one of two paths: move forward if the front is clear, turn right if there is a wall. Because the decision is made at every step, the same program can handle one or two corners.
hints: The robot crashes because it always calls forward(). When should it turn instead?
Inside the while: if front_clear(): forward() and else: turn_right().
else must line up with its if, and its body is indented 4 more spaces.
